layer: vendor conversion engine; no host algorithm copy
status: source regression and full vendor suite passed; rebuilt preview.36 bundle/package quality matrix still required
rootCause: Digit-masked grouping treated any physically page-tracking number as proof for the whole line, freezing other per-page IDs.
Only first/middle/last probes were validated, allowing intervening mismatches.
Unlabelled case/form/step numbers could coincide with physical page numbers and be mistaken for running page fields.
algorithm: For mixed content, only explicitly labelled digit runs can be PAGE fields, and each must equal its physical page on every member.
Replace all proven counters from right to left. Require the remaining literal template to be exactly identical before dropping any mixed-content line.
When proof fails, keep original line content in the document body.

supportedMixedPageLabels.prefixBoundary: Must begin at a token boundary with no preceding Unicode letter or number. Case-insensitive; optional one of dot, colon or hash and whitespace before digits. GROUP/STEP trailing P is not the P label.
supportedMixedPageLabels.conservativeFallback: Unrecognised or unlabelled mixed numbering remains in the body. This may repeat a header, but preserves its content.

preservedContracts: Ordinary Page N of M fields and all explicitly labelled duplicate PAGE occurrences.
Constant revision/year/total numbers and fullwidth page digits.
Original bare/worded page-number offset and roman behavior; no new promise of offset-page reproduction.

regressions.redBeforeFix: Original title sample and adjacent cases first failed; semantic hardening independently reproduced 7 failures, including two real PDF conversions.

fullSuite.note: 7 pre-existing system-font-conditional CJK/RTL tests remain skipped; the separate preview.35 quality matrix has a real simhei.ttf Chinese text-layer case.

testEnvironmentFix.change: Explicit ASCII thisProgram in test-only PDFium bootstrap.
testEnvironmentFix.reason: Chinese test-runner entry paths otherwise assert in Emscripten ASCII environment initialization. Production bundled converter already has its own ASCII thisProgram.

upstreamPolicy.keepPatchUntil: An adopted official engine proves equivalent all-member, labelled-counter and invariant-literal checks or a safer preservation strategy, and passes the unchanged three-page failure PDF, real form/case near-neighbours, full suite and rebuilt 10-case worker quality matrix.
upstreamPolicy.deletePatchOnlyAfter: Record official commit identity, remove private delta without copying it to the host, rerun the same regressions/matrix, and refresh the upstream patch manifest and source/resource lock.

limitations: This is semantic furniture classification, not a pixel-perfect-layout guarantee.
A P-labelled number still relies on the conventional P-as-page interpretation; unsupported mixed dialects conservatively remain body content.
The old preview.35 package and both failure reports remain unchanged; no preview.36 installation or package-validation claim is made here.
